exam.exam_name: Arunachal PSC Direct Recruitments (Assistant Public Prosecutor, Sub-Treasury Officer, Labour Officer, Veterinary Officer, ADO, Technical Cadres)
exam.conducting_body: Arunachal Pradesh Public Service Commission (APPSC), Itanagar

source_evidence.captured_wording: Candidates must upload scanned copy of recent photograph (40-100 KB) and signature (20-50 KB) in JPG/JPEG format.
source_evidence.document_title: Direct Recruitment Advertisements for Technical and Professional Posts in Government of Arunachal Pradesh

dimensions.fallback_reason: The body publishes a preferred pixel size without mandating it, so the size is honoured while the mode stays unspecified.

requirements.content_instructions: JPG, JPEG; 3.5 cm x 4.5 cm; 3.5 cm x 4.5 cm; Light/White; APPSC portal image validator

image_requirements.file_size.evidence_reference: Direct Recruitment Advertisements for Technical and Professional Posts in Government of Arunachal Pradesh - Instructions to Candidates, Clause 5 (https://appsc.gov.in)
image_requirements.file_size.reasoning: Byte ceiling converted from the published figure using 1 KB = 1000 bytes. No body in the researched set defines the unit, and the decimal reading is the smaller of the two, so a file satisfying it also satisfies a 1024-byte reading.

image_requirements.dimensions.evidence_reference: Direct Recruitment Advertisements for Technical and Professional Posts in Government of Arunachal Pradesh - Instructions to Candidates, Clause 5 (https://appsc.gov.in)
image_requirements.dimensions.reasoning: Pixel dimensions transcribed from the cited source.

image_requirements.formats.preferred_for.reasoning: The body lists permitted formats without naming a preference. JPEG is selected from the permitted list; JPG and JPEG name the same format, so this chooses a spelling rather than a format.

image_requirements.composition.crop_prof.reasoning: One composition is used for every examination: the tightest crop that keeps hair, ears and the chin/beard boundary intact. No researched body publishes a coverage maximum this would breach, and all published minima are cleared by it.
